title: Accessibility
introduction: These messages concern potential problems of accessibility of content by print disabled people.

messages.message: Html "a" element must have text.
Table heading cells should be identified by "th" elements for accessibility.
Tables should include a "thead" element for accessibility.
Content Documents do not use "epub:type" attributes for semantic inflection.
MathML should either have an "alttext" attribute or "annotation-xml" child element.
messages.explanation: All meaningful non-text content that is presented to the user should have a textual alternative that describes the content. The "alttext" attribute or "annotation-xml" child element can be used for MathML content.

messages.message: SVG hyperlinks should have a human-readable title (using the "title" child element or the "xlink:title" attribute).
messages.explanation: Visual interactive content that is presented to the user should have a textual alternative. The "title" child element or the "xlink:title" attribute can be used for SVG links.

introduction: These messages are about parsing errors of files passed to EPUBCheck to customize the severity and checks' messages. Files can be supplied using `-c` or `--customMessages` and `-l` or `--listChecks` arguments.

title: CSS
introduction: These messages are alerts about Cascading Style Sheets in the checked EPUB.

messages.message: The "%1$s" property must not be included in an EPUB Style Sheet.
messages.explanation: EPUB specifications says authors must not use the direction and unicode-bidi CSS properties. Use the HTML dir attribute to set the inline base direction, use bdo elements and dir attributes to control bidirectionality.

title: NAV EPUB v3 Table of contents

messages.message: The nav file is not supported for EPUB v2.
messages.explanation: The EPUB 2 format does not support the nav file; to define the Content Table and PageList use the NCX file, for landmarks use the <guide> element in the OPF file.

messages.message: The Navigation Document must have a page list when content document(s) contain page breaks (epub:type="pagebreak").
messages.explanation: Page breaks identify the points at which the paper pages of the document are interrupted. For this reason, if they are present, it is necessary to indicate the page number in the nav page list element.
